sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration Department: current official eVisa link
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Immigration Department homepage labels www.evisa.sl its Official Portal and directs applicants to apply there.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply eVisa Official Portal Apply online via the official Sierra Leone eVisa portal.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa: current terms and FAQ frontend text
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs / Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SLID currently links directly to evisa.sl as its official portal; the active portal terms identify the Ministry of Internal Affairs as operator.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If your eVisa application is accepted, we will be sending you the eVisa as an email attachment.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa: live United States nationality selector response
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs / Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The URL is the live API used by SLID-authenticated evisa.sl; it returns current visitor visa forms and fees for the selected United States nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa for Non African Union nationals. Validity of the Visa: 365 days.

sources.title: National Tourist Board: live arrival guidance and dated 2019 schedule
sources.officialityEvidence: The current NTB government-domain page presents its own visitor guidance, but contains both an undated all-visitor arrival statement and a dated 2019 narrower schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors do not need to apply for a travel visa beforehand, just jet in and you obtain visa.

sources.title: ECOWAS current Member States
sources.publisher: Economic Community of West African States
sources.officialityEvidence: The ECOWAS Commission publishes its current Member States roster, which is necessary to interpret the eVisa terms' ECOWAS exclusion.

unresolved.reason: The live Immigration-authenticated eVisa terms directly name all countries except ECOWAS as permitted, but the same current terms say an accepted eVisa is emailed while the live FAQ says it is issued on arrival. The Tourist Board's live page also has an undated all-visitor arrival statement beside a dated, narrower 2019 schedule. Current official material therefore does not establish one normalized issuance timing for this ordinary-passport visitor pair; no status is assigned.

Current official material therefore does not establish one normalized issuance timing for this ordinary-passport visitor pair; no status is assigned.
